name: Tanker
description: A 250 m crude / product tanker (Aframax-like) with the house aft, long flat deck, pipelines, a manifold amidships, a raised catwalk and a provision crane.

param_docs.beam_m: Moulded breadth, metres. Bridge wings run out to the ship's side.
param_docs.draught_m: Design (loaded) draught, metres. The keel sits at minus this; the origin is the waterline amidships.
param_docs.depth_m: Moulded depth keel to main deck, metres. Freeboard = depth - draught; a loaded tanker has a low freeboard.
param_docs.forecastle_height_m: How far the forecastle deck stands above the main deck, metres.
param_docs.house_front_frac: Where the front of the accommodation is, as a fraction of LOA from amidships (negative = aft).
param_docs.house_tiers: Decks in the accommodation block below the bridge (2.8 m each).
param_docs.pipelines: Number of longitudinal cargo pipelines running along the deck.
param_docs.manifold_x_frac: Where the cargo manifold is, as a fraction of LOA from amidships (0 = amidships).
param_docs.manifold_connections: Cargo hose connections on each side at the manifold.
param_docs.cargo_tanks: Number of cargo tank pairs; each pair gets two deck hatches.
param_docs.provision_crane_jib_m: Jib length of the provision crane by the house, metres.
param_docs.deck_color: Main deck colour (red oxide by default), RGB 0-1.
param_docs.superstructure_color: Accommodation, wheelhouse and bridge wings colour, RGB 0-1.
param_docs.funnel_band_color: Company band on the funnel, RGB 0-1.
param_docs.pipe_color: Cargo pipework and manifold colour, RGB 0-1.

meta.name: Tanker (250 m Aframax-like crude/product)
meta.notes: Proportions from typical Aframax tankers (about 245-250 m x 44 m x 14.8 m, L/B 5.7). Single screw, single rudder.
